name: Squat
instructions: Stand side-on to the camera, feet shoulder-width apart. Sit back and down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, chest up, then drive through your heels to stand.

name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Face the camera. Jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead, then jump back to feet together, arms down. Keep a steady rhythm.

name: Alternating Lunge
instructions: Stand side-on. Step forward and lower until both knees are near 90°, torso upright. Push back to standing and alternate legs. Each lunge counts as one rep.

name: Push-up
instructions: Place the phone on the floor, side-on, about 2 m away. Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. Lower your chest toward the floor until elbows reach ~90°, then press up.

name: Plank
instructions: Phone on the floor, side-on. Forearms down, elbows under shoulders, body straight from shoulders to ankles. The timer only runs while your hips stay level.

name: March in Place
instructions: March on the spot, lifting knees to hip height and swinging your arms. Gradually increase pace to warm up.

name: Arm Circles
instructions: Extend arms to the sides and make small circles, growing larger. Switch direction halfway.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Drive hips up until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. Squeeze and lower slowly.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Back flat against a wall, slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor. Hold, knees over ankles.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: In a push-up position, drive alternate knees toward your chest quickly while keeping hips level.

name: High Knees
instructions: Run on the spot, driving knees up to hip height, pumping arms.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent. Lift shoulders off the floor using your abs, chin off chest, then lower with control.

name: Superman Hold
instructions: Lie face down, arms extended. Lift arms, chest and legs off the floor and hold.

name: Incline Push-up
instructions: Hands on a desk or bed edge, body straight. Lower your chest to the edge and press back up. Easier than a floor push-up.
